# muxt fmt reads CSS from the templates of a file's own package. A file in
# another directory is in another package: walking both does not let the
# <style> element in b reach page.gohtml, so the span stays inline and its
# line is left as written.

muxt fmt page.gohtml
cmp stdout page.orig
muxt fmt -w .
cmp page.gohtml page.orig

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.24
-- m.go --
package m

import "embed"

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templates embed.FS
-- page.gohtml --
<p>a<span class="x">b</span> c</p>
-- page.orig --
<p>a<span class="x">b</span> c</p>
-- b/b.go --
package b

import "embed"

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templates embed.FS
-- b/style.gohtml --
<style>.x{display:block}</style>
